name: two_tuples
note: chosen by hand: two of the four listed tuples, which still close the cycle (V,P) = (0,0),(2,1),(0,0),(2,1); a model that hardcodes the CSPLib tuples can return a solution this table rejects

name: four_cycle
note: chosen by hand: tuples chain the states (0,0)->(2,1)->(1,0)->(3,0)->(0,0), so the only solutions are the four rotations of one 4-cycle; tests the (V_i, P_i, V_i+1, P_i+1) order and the wrap from light 4 to light 1

name: dead_end
note: chosen by hand: a 2-cycle (0,1)<->(3,0) plus two tuples (1,1)->(2,0)->(2,1) that never return, so only the 2-cycle solutions remain

name: self_loop
note: chosen by hand: the self-loop (1,1)->(1,1) is the only closed cycle, so the unique solution sets every light to the same state; the other two tuples form a chain that does not close
